mine: your basket and your kneading bowl
note: mish'eret is the kneading trough (Exod 12:34), not a store. Same in v. 17.
The MT vowels read bacherev "sword". In a list of crop and body afflictions, I repointed it as choreb "drought" (same consonants). The KJV follows the MT here.

kjv: shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth
mine: you (Israel) will be a horror to all the kingdoms of the earth
note: za'avah (qere) means terror or horror (cf. Jer 15:4). The KJV took it from zua' "to move".

kjv: the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods
mine: the boils of Egypt, with tumors
note: 'ofalim (qere techorim) are tumours or haemorrhoids. "Emerods" and "botch" are obsolete English.

kjv: toward her (the tender and refined woman's) young one that cometh out from between her feet
mine: her (the tender and refined woman's) afterbirth that comes out from between her feet
note: shilyatah is the afterbirth (placenta). The children are mentioned separately in the same verse, so "young one" misreads the horror of the siege.
